entries.limitation: Cannot read scanned PDFs or photos of handwritten receipts.
entries.checkWhen: A thread or expense batch includes image attachments or camera scans.
entries.workaround: Run optical character recognition (OCR) before pasting, or attach plain-text exports.

entries.limitation: Assumes bare numbers in a single thread share the same currency unless a symbol is written.
entries.checkWhen: Customers from two countries quote prices without currency codes (e.g. '40' vs '$40').
entries.workaround: Write the three-letter currency code (USD, EUR, JPY) in the prompt or first line.

entries.limitation: Truncates threads longer than 80 messages to the first 10 and most recent 70 messages.
entries.checkWhen: Summarising multi-month enterprise tickets with more than 80 replies.
entries.workaround: Split the ticket by quarter or export only the billing sub-thread.

entries.limitation: Can misread dry sarcasm as literal agreement in frustrated customer emails.
entries.checkWhen: A customer writes short replies with exclamation marks after an outage.
entries.workaround: Read the highlighted source line yourself whenever a tone note appears in the margin.

entries.limitation: Previously shifted timestamps by one hour across daylight-saving transition weeks.
entries.checkWhen: Checking audit log dates from late March or late October.
entries.workaround: Resolved in v0.14.2 by preserving original ISO offsets from message headers.
